name: FM drone
description: VCO 3 unplugged from the keyboard modulates the pitch of all VCOs at audio rate: metallic drone that changes with each note.
tidal: d1 $ n "<0 3 7 5>" # s "scstd" # o1lvl 0 # o2wave 3 # o3kbd 0 # o3oct (-1) # vco3_pitch 4 # vcfcut 4000 # vcfenv 0 # arrel 1.5 # aratk 0.3 # legato 1
